title: Faithful Explanations under Missing Modalities in Multimodal Dementia Prognosis
abstract: arXiv:2610.35430v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to turn the feature attributions of multimodal prognostic models into narratives for clinicians, yet costly modalities such as amyloid PET and cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers are often missing, and whether these explanations stay faithful under missing evidence has not been tested. We separate two failure points: phantom attribution, in which the model credits modalities that were never observed, and unfaithful narration, in which the report omits, cites or misjudges missing modalities. Using 307 participants of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative with complete data, we masked every subset of four costly modalities, predicted 36-month conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's disease, and restored the masked data to obtain interventional ground truth. translated_title: 多模态痴呆预后中模态缺失情况下的忠实解释
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被用于将多模态预后模型的特征归因转化为面向临床医生的叙述性报告，然而淀粉样蛋白PET和脑脊液生物标志物等昂贵的模态经常缺失，而这些解释在证据缺失情况下是否依然忠实尚未得到检验。我们区分了两类失败点：一是“幻影归因”，即模型为从未观测到的模态赋予归因贡献；二是“不忠实叙述”，即报告遗漏、引用或误判缺失的模态。我们使用阿尔茨海默病神经影像学计划（ADNI）中307名数据完整的参与者，对四种昂贵模态的所有子集进行掩码处理，预测36个月内从轻度认知障碍向阿尔茨海默病的转化，并恢复被掩码的数据以获得干预性的真实基准。所有五种缺失数据策略都将12%至23%的归因分配给了未观测到的模态，在四种……时高达45%（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究首次系统检验了多模态痴呆预后中大语言模型解释在模态缺失时的忠实性，提出“幻影归因”和“不忠实叙述”两类失败模式，并发现所有缺失数据处理策略都会将12%-23%（最高达45%）的归因错误分配给从未观测到的昂贵模态。
en_tdlr: This work is the first to systematically test the faithfulness of LLM-generated explanations in multimodal dementia prognosis under missing modalities, identifying phantom attribution and unfaithful narration as two failure modes, and showing that all missing-data strategies assign 12%–23% (up to 45%) of attribution to never-observed modalities.
